Software Engineering MCQs 
In this article, we are going to discuss the most commonly asked multiple-choice 
questions related to Software Engineering. 
The primary purpose of writing this article is to target competitive exams and 
interviews. Here, we will cover all the frequently asked Software Engineering 
questions with the correct choice of answer among various options.

a. 
System Design 
b. Coding 
c. System Testing 
d. Preliminary Investigation and Analysis
